name: Fuentes Archive
subtitle: SideStore source for the unsigned build
description: Unsigned Fuentes Archive builds. The IPA is the latest GitHub Release asset. Add this file as a SideStore source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ry-pi/fuentes-archive/main/sidestore/apps.json

apps.name: Fuentes Archive
apps.subtitle: New videos from the Rumble Videos tab
apps.localizedDescription: Watches https://rumble.com/c/nickjfuentes/videos and saves new public uploads into the Files app. Shorts, livestreams, and the All tab are not downloaded. No App Store account and no paid signing entitlements.

versions.localizedDescription: First sideload build. Videos-tab sync, background downloads, Wi-Fi only, quality picker, local RSS export.

appPermissions.usageDescription: Optional. Copies a finished download into Photos when that setting is on. The file is always kept in the Files app.
